archived_listing_finding.note: True means the API DELETE performed a soft archive -- the disposable still appears under ?archived=true after being deleted. False means it does not reappear there.

calculation_formula: if coalesce(lv_anti_icp_flag, 0) = 1 then "D" elseif coalesce(lv_icp_fit_score, -1) >= 70 then "A" elseif coalesce(lv_icp_fit_score, -1) >= 40 then "B" elseif coalesce(lv_icp_fit_score, -1) >= 15 then "C" else "Unscored"
